name: MrpTimePhasedGrid
tagline: The classic MRP record in Power Apps – netting, lot sizing, pegging and exception messages.
description: A PCF control that runs a full time-phased MRP calculation in Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages: forecast consumption, multi-level BOM explosion with low-level codes, lot sizing (L4L, FOQ, POQ, EOQ, min/max), lead-time offsetting, planning and demand time fences, pegging, firm planned orders, release and an exception workbench with expedite, defer, cancel and past-due messages.
features: Gross, scheduled, projected, net, planned receipts and releases per week or day
Forecast consumption with demand time fence
Multi-level BOM explosion with low-level codes and scrap
Lot sizing: L4L, FOQ, POQ, EOQ, min/max, multiples, max-qty split, yield
Planning time fence with shortage messages
Expedite, defer, cancel, past-due release and safety-stock exceptions
Pegging to sales orders, forecast and parent planned orders
Firm, change and release planned orders (actionJson output)
Exception workbench and KPI strip with planned order value
Phone period cards, tablet item picker, keyboard grid navigation
